findings.claim: Failed Armor gain at Heavily Injured incorrectly requires an external nonBackpackVisibility policy and can reveal the discarded armor, contradicting the source-completeness amendment that failed Armor gain uses the Items discard pile without an external policy and the A-5 block scope (non-Backpack stored Items only).
findings.evidence: planStorage checks `if (!policies.nonBackpackVisibility) return { gaps: [SEARCH_GAPS.NON_BACKPACK_VISIBILITY] };` before the `healthSection === 'heavily-injured'` branch; publicGainEvent includes `itemId` for `item-discard` when visibility is 'public'.
findings.disposition_test: Call resolveSearch with armor at heavily-injured and no nonBackpackVisibility policy; expected resolved with itemDiscard ['a1'] and no public itemId; actual unresolved NON_BACKPACK_VISIBILITY.

findings.claim: The action-card reveal event is emitted after resolution/storage effects, not before resolution as RB 3177-3179 requires.
findings.evidence: Code pushes `action-card-revealed` after `applyStorage` and after the action card is removed from hand and placed on discard.
findings.disposition_test: Inspect publicEvents and state at the point the reveal event is emitted; expected reveal before storage/discard; actual storage and discard already applied.

findings.claim: The zero-or-one keep policy silently defaults the return order for multiple unchosen same-color cards to draw order, a source ambiguity not recorded as a gap.
findings.evidence: The return loop pushes unchosen candidates in draw order; source only says 'others to respective deck bottoms' without ordering.
findings.disposition_test: Room with two green icons, policy zero-or-one, no keep; expected unresolved or explicit order policy; actual resolved with deck ['g3','g1','g2'].

findings.claim: The nonBackpackVisibility policy accepts any truthy value and treats anything other than exactly 'public' as secret, a hidden default.
findings.evidence: `if (plan.storage !== 'backpack' && plan.visibility === 'public')` with no validation of the policy value.
findings.disposition_test: Pass `nonBackpackVisibility: 'banana'`; expected invalid or unresolved; actual resolved with secret visibility.

findings.claim: `tacticalGearFilled` defaults to 0 when `tacticalGearSlots` is undefined, potentially masking missing item data.
findings.disposition_test: Item definition without `tacticalGearSlots`; expected unresolved or explicit; actual resolved with 0.

findings.claim: `validateInput` rejects rooms with no item icons, an invented restriction not present in the supplied source.
findings.disposition_test: Room with empty itemIcons; expected resolved with no draws or unresolved; actual illegal.

findings.claim: `appliedSources` cites RB:3543-3548 finite-component fallback, but the contract returns unresolved for an empty deck rather than applying that fallback.
findings.evidence: appliedSources includes 'RB:3543-3548'; empty deck returns unresolved EMPTY_ITEM_DECK.
findings.disposition_test: Empty required deck; citation is misleading because the finite-component fallback is not applied.

findings.claim: The M05 mutation is a strawman: it changes selection to title comparison but leaves the input as an occurrence id, so the kill is due to type mismatch rather than duplicate-title distinction.
findings.evidence: Mutation `candidates.find(({ itemId }) => next.items[itemId].title === keepOccurrenceId)` with test input `keepOccurrenceId: 'g2'`; title 'MEDKIT' !== 'g2'.
findings.disposition_test: A faithful title-selection mutation would require a title input; the current kill does not demonstrate protection against title-based selection.

findings.claim: The keep-cardinality policy is not recorded in the resolved result, so the authority/interpretation is not auditable downstream.
findings.evidence: Result includes `appliedSources` but not the `policies` used; preregistration M13 says 'without recording authority/interpretation'.
findings.disposition_test: Resolved result with policy exactly-one; expected policy recorded; actual absent.

findings.claim: Not-in-combat rejection returns gap A-6 even though preregistration scenario 10 treats rejection without state mutation as source-clear.
findings.disposition_test: Not-in-combat play; expected illegal with no gaps; actual gaps [A-6].

mutation_adequacy: M01-M04 and M06-M14 are killed by non-tautological assertions; M05 kill is weak/strawman (F-8).
Harness anchor count assertions pass; no mutation survives the acceptance suite.
M12 kill relies on undefined itemId propagation but still fails the status assertion.
utility_gate_risks: The compact contract already encodes all source decisions and gaps, so the semantic corpus may have no unique utility (H2 risk).
The failed-Armor visibility overreach could mask a semantic contribution about discarded-item visibility.
Coarse gaps A-2/A-3 and A-5 may hide finer semantic distinctions the corpus could provide.
must_fix_before_verdict: F-1: remove the nonBackpackVisibility requirement for the failed Armor gain path and do not reveal discarded armor unless source-supported.
F-2: emit action-card-revealed before resolution effects per RB 3177-3179.
F-3: record the multi-unchosen return-order ambiguity as a gap or require an explicit order policy for zero-or-one.
F-8: replace the M05 mutation with a faithful title-selection mutation or add a title-input test.
